general.content: welcome to the testing server! This is the general channel for project Beacon. Our goal is to ship v2.0 by end of Q3.
alice what's the current timeline? Last I heard frontend was behind.
bob we pushed the beta to Aug 15 and GA to Sep 30. We'll discuss in standup.
can someone link the new API docs? I need to update the mobile client.
carol the docs are at https://docs.beacon.io/api/v2 — we published them yesterday.
thanks dave! The new /users/batch endpoint is exactly what we needed.
heads up: the Stripe integration will be delayed by a week. Their new API version broke our webhook handler.
eve can we ship without payments? Or is it blocking the beta?
alice it's only blocking premium features. Free tier can ship without it. We can gate it behind a feature flag.
decision: ship beta without payments behind feature flag. Eve you own the Stripe fix, target Sep 1.
does anyone know why the CI pipeline is failing on main? The Docker build step is erroring out.
frank it's the new base image — they deprecated Ubuntu 20.04. I'll push a fix to bump to 22.04.
thanks dave. also the test suite takes 45 minutes now. Can we split it?
frank I'll parallelize the test runners this sprint. Target: under 15 minutes.
is the new search endpoint ready for QA? The ticket says it's in review.
bob it's in code review with heidi. Should be done by EOD.
just approved the search PR. Bob it's all yours for QA.
great, I'll start testing now. First finding: search doesn't handle unicode characters properly.
bob can you file a bug? I'll fix the unicode normalization in the tokenizer.
ivan filed as BEACON-442 with reproduction steps.
team: we have a stakeholder demo on Friday. I need demo-ready state on the onboarding flow by Thursday EOD.

bugs.content: bug: search returns 500 when query contains emoji. Reproduced on staging. Steps: GET /api/v2/search?q=hello🔥
bob confirmed the root cause — the elasticsearch query builder doesn't escape 4-byte UTF-8 characters. Fix incoming.
fix for BEACON-442: added Unicode normalization in the tokenizer. PR up for review.
ivan reviewed and approved BEACON-442 fix. Merged to main.
bug: mobile app crashes on logout when biometric auth is enabled. iOS 17.4, iPhone 14 Pro.
carol I can reproduce. The Keychain wipe is racing with the session invalidation. Fix: serialize the teardown.
frank fix works on my end. PR submitted with test coverage for the race condition.
bug: database connection pool exhaustion under load. Seeing 'remaining connections: 0' errors at 500 concurrent users.
root cause: the analytics middleware opens a connection per request but doesn't release it on error paths. Fix: switch to connection pooling with context managers.
dave we should also add PGBouncer in front of Postgres. I'll set that up in the staging environment first.
grace agreed. Target: PGBouncer on staging by Wednesday, then production after a week of validation.
bug: webhook delivery is retrying infinitely for 4xx responses. Stripe returns 422 for duplicate events and we keep retrying.
fix: stop retrying on 4xx status codes. Only retry on 5xx and network errors. Added exponential backoff with max 3 retries.
eve reviewed the webhook retry fix. One suggestion: add a dead-letter queue for failed 4xx events so we don't lose them entirely.
heidi good call. Added DLQ with SQS. Events that hit 4xx go to a review queue with manual replay.
bug: pagination cursor returns duplicate results when documents are updated during iteration.
bob that's a known pattern — use a snapshot cursor or freeze the ordering. I'll implement cursor-based pagination with a stable sort key (created_at + id).
bug count update: we have 23 open bugs, 12 closed this sprint. Priority: BEACON-442 (search unicode) and the connection pool issue.

feature-requests.content: feature: offline mode for the mobile app. Users in the feedback survey keep asking for it. Priority: P2.
carol offline mode is a big lift. We'd need a local SQLite store, sync engine, and conflict resolution. Estimate: 3 sprints minimum.
frank can we do an MVP? Just read-only cache of recent data with basic sync?
carol yeah MVP is doable in 1 sprint. Let me spec it out and we can scope it for next sprint planning.
carol and frank I want a written proposal for the offline MVP before sprint planning on Monday.
feature: webhook event replay UI in the admin dashboard. Support teams keep asking us to re-send webhook events manually.
dave I've been wanting this too. I can build the backend endpoint that replays events from the event store.
eve perfect. I'll handle the frontend. Let's sync on the API contract tomorrow.
feature: canary deployments with automatic rollback. We're deploying too often and breaks slip through.
grace great idea. We can use Argo Rollouts for Kubernetes. I'll set up a PoC for the API service first.
dave start with the API service since it's stateless. We'll do the worker services next sprint.
feature: rate limiting headers on all public API endpoints. Some clients are hammering us without backpressure.
ivan +1. Let's use the standard IETF RateLimit headers (RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset).
alice exactly what I was thinking. I'll implement it as middleware so all endpoints get it automatically.
feature request from the security team: audit log for all admin actions. Who changed what and when.
heidi that's a compliance requirement for our SOC2 audit. We need it by end of August. Let's make it P1.
alice I'll write the spec. The audit log needs to be append-only and immutable. Thinking: use the event store with a separate partition.
heidi sounds good. Pull in dave for the data model design.

devops.content: we need to migrate off Ubuntu 20.04 base images by end of month. Ubuntu 20.04 is EOL.
dave I tested the 22.04 migration on staging. The only breaking change is the Python 3.10 vs 3.8 default. Our code is compatible.
grace great. I'll update the Dockerfiles and CI matrix today. Target: production cutover Wednesday.
PGBouncer is running on staging. Connection pooling is working. Pool size: 20 connections, max 100 clients queued. Latency dropped 40%.
grace impressive numbers. Let's run it for a week before production deploy.
dave agreed. I configured the same pool settings for production. We can switch over Sep 1.
the Kubernetes cluster is hitting 80% memory usage on the worker nodes. We need to either scale up or optimize.
eve I see the biggest consumer is the analytics worker. It loads the entire event log into memory. Let me add pagination to the event processor.
grace also we should set up HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) based on memory utilization.
eve I'll configure HPA this week. Min 3, max 10 pods, target 70% memory.
incident: production database had a failover at 2:30 AM. The replica lag was 45 seconds. Automated failover kicked in, 2 minutes of downtime.
post-mortem: the primary ran out of disk space for WAL logs. Fix: increased disk from 100GB to 500GB and set up disk alerts at 80%.
dave we should automate the WAL archiving to S3 instead of local disk.
grace yes, that's now on the roadmap. I'll set up WAL archiving to S3 with lifecycle policies.
CI/CD pipeline is now using GitHub Actions cache for Docker layers. Build time dropped from 12 min to 4 min.
frank that's huge. Did you also split the test and build stages?
dave yes, they run in parallel now. Total pipeline time: 6 minutes for the full suite.
added Loki + Grafana for log aggregation. Query: 'rate of 5xx errors over the last hour' is now a single click.
grace can you share the Grafana dashboard link? I want to monitor this during the demo.
alice https://grafana.beacon.io/d/beacon-prod — I'll add a shareable view for stakeholders.

design.content: new onboarding flow mockups are ready. Key change: reduce from 5 steps to 3 steps. Drop the 'profile setup' and 'preferences' steps.
carol where are the mockups? I want to review before the stakeholder demo on Friday.
alice they're on Figma: https://figma.com/beacon/onboarding-v2. The happy path is now: Sign Up -> Verify Email -> First Action.
carol I reviewed the designs. The loading state on the email verification screen needs a spinner and timeout message.
heidi good catch. I'll add a skeleton loader with a 30-second timeout that shows a 'resend email' option.
carol can we make the 'First Action' step configurable? Different user segments have different first actions.
frank I'll design it as a dynamic section that can show different CTAs based on user role. The backend just needs to return the content in the onboarding config endpoint.
carol decision: go with the 3-step flow. Feature flag it behind 'onboarding-v2'. All existing users see the old flow, new users see the new one.
alice I'll add the feature flag to the designs. The implementation should be straightforward with the existing toggle framework.
design feedback: the mobile navigation is hard to reach one-handed. The search bar is at the top but thumb reach is mid-screen.
bob you're right. I'll move the search bar to a bottom sheet that slides up. The nav tabs stay at the bottom per platform conventions.
design v2 of the dashboard: replaced the pie chart with a horizontal bar chart. Metric cards now show trend arrows (up/down/flat) with % change.
carol the trend arrows are great. Can we add sparklines for the last 7 days?
alice yes, I included sparklines in the Figma but they're easy to miss. I'll make them more prominent with a mini-chart area.
design question: what should the payments page look like when payments are disabled? Should it show a 'coming soon' state?
eve I'll add a 'payments paused' empty state with a banner explaining the delay and an email signup for notification when it's ready.
carol the error pages need updating. The current 404 just says 'Not Found'. Can we make it helpful?
grace yes. I'll design a 404 page with: search bar, link to home, and suggested pages based on the URL path.

code-review.content: reviewing PR #847: Unicode tokenizer fix by ivan. Code is clean, tests pass, edge cases covered. Approved.
heidi thanks for the fast review. I added test cases for surrogate pairs and zero-width joiners as you suggested.
reviewing PR #851: Offline mode MVP by frank. Architecture looks good but the sync conflict resolution needs more thought.
heidi can you elaborate? I'm using last-write-wins with a timestamp comparison. What edge case are you thinking about?
frank the problem is clock skew across devices. If the user edits on their phone (clock is 2min ahead) then on desktop, the desktop edit is silently dropped. Use a vector clock or CRDT instead.
heidi that's a good point. For the MVP, can we use server-timestamps only? The client sends its local change and the server resolves conflicts.
frank that works for the MVP. But document the limitation and plan CRDTs for v2. Approved with that caveat.

reviewing PR #853: Audit log implementation by heidi (self-review). Schema: event_id UUID, actor_id UUID, action TEXT, resource_type TEXT, resource_id UUID, details JSONB, timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ. Indexes on actor_id, resource_id, timestamp. Append-only trigger enforced at DB level.
heidi approved. The append-only trigger is critical — make sure it's tested in migration tests.
reviewing PR #855: Webhook event replay endpoint by eve. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/admin/webhooks/:id/replay. Returns the new delivery attempt ID.
heidi I also added idempotency: replaying the same event within 5 minutes returns the existing delivery ID.
eve nice touch. Approved. One suggestion: add rate limiting to this endpoint (max 10 replays per minute per admin).
heidi added rate limiting. Max 10/min with a 429 response when exceeded.
reviewing PR #858: Rate limiting middleware by ivan. Implementation uses the Generic Cell Rate Algorithm (GCRA) for rate tracking. Clean and well-tested.
heidi the GCRA is the same algorithm used by the kernel's network scheduler. It's memory-efficient — only stores the next allowed time per client.
ivan approved. The RateLimit headers are correctly implemented per the IETF draft.

does anyone have a good docker compose file for local Postgres with pgvector? I'm tired of managing it manually.

bob here's mine:
version: '3'
services:
  postgres:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: localdev
    ports:
      - 5432:5432
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
volumes:
  pgdata:
